newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Global EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Global EPS view cut.

text.p: -- Montgomery Securities on Tuesday said analysts Tom Courtney and Kevin Dede cut their first-quarter and 1997 estimates for Global DirectMail Corp's earnings per share (EPS).
-- In a report, they reduced their first-quarter EPS estimate to $0.33 from $0.37 and their 1997 estimate to $1.40 from $1.45.
-- Their EPS estimates for the second and fourth quarters were unchanged at $0.33 and $0.39, respectively. The EPS estimate for the third quarter was cut to $0.35 from $0.36.

-- "We have revised the assumptions in our first quarter estimate to reflect lower profitability overseas due mainly to the negative impact from the stronger dollar and the related currency translation," Dede and Courtney wrote.
-- The 1997 estimate was reduced "as a result of expected continued exchange rate pressure."

-- Shares in the Port Washington, N.Y., direct marketing company had fallen 7-1/2 to 20-1/2 before the New York Stock Exchange near midday halted trade in the shares for news pending. More than 2.02 million shares had changed hands, compared with an average daily volume of 84,000.
-- The analysts kept their buy rating on the stock.
